Messages.Author: Michael Beer
Messages.Body:
Card Text:

"Political Card-Worth 1 Vote.Prince or Justicar calls at +1
stealth.Successful vote means each Methuselah must skip a turn or burn 2
pool. Burn this card when you have either skipped 3 turns or paid 6 pool
in cumulative penalties."

Question:

Is 1st Tradition burned when:

- The "you" in the card text refers to ME, so that, for example, 1st
Trad. is burned when I have skipped 3 turns (so that the card lasts 3
turns at least)?

- The "you" in the card text refers to all methusalahs, so that, for
example in a 4 player game, I play the card, the 3 other Methusalahs pay
the price and the card is burned? Effectively the card lasts 1 turn for
all methusalahs as a whole, but 3 turns for different methusalahs.

In our most recent game, I played the card in the spirit of the former
interpretation, but was voted down by the other players, who preferred
the latter one.

--

Michael Beer, Dortmund, Germany, ICQ 1175389
